articles.title: OpenAI Announces GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Chain
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring a unified reasoning architecture that natively interleaves text, image, audio, and code generation within a single chain-of-thought pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements on ARC-AGI-2 benchmarks and reduces hallucination rates by approximately 40% compared to GPT-4.5, largely attributed to a new self-consistency verification layer during inference.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Foundation Model Achieves Zero-Shot Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: DeepMind published results showing its Gemini Robotics model can perform complex multi-step manipulation tasks in cluttered, never-before-seen household environments without fine-tuning. The system combines a vision-language-action architecture with real-time physics simulation to plan grasps and tool use, achieving an 87% success rate across 150 novel task configurations in independent evaluations.

articles.title: EU AI Act Full Enforcement Begins as Companies Race to Comply with High-Risk System Requirements
articles.summary: The EU AI Act's high-risk system provisions officially took effect this month, requiring companies deploying AI in hiring, credit scoring, healthcare, and law enforcement to meet strict transparency, auditing, and human-oversight mandates. Major cloud providers including AWS and Azure have rolled out compliance dashboards, while several startups report pivoting product roadmaps to avoid the high-risk classification entirely.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots have started operating in select third-party logistics warehouses outside of Tesla's own factories for the first time. The robots handle bin picking, palletizing, and inventory scanning tasks, with Tesla reporting a 3x improvement in battery endurance over Gen 2, enabling full 8-hour shifts on a single charge.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Sentinel: An AI System That Audits Other AI Systems for Safety Violations
articles.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Sentinel, a specialized model designed to monitor and audit deployed AI systems in real time, flagging outputs that violate safety policies, exhibit reasoning failures, or drift from intended behavior. The tool integrates via API middleware and is aimed at enterprises running multi-model pipelines, addressing a growing need for automated AI governance at scale.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node, roughly one quarter ahead of its original timeline. The node leverages gate-all-around nanosheet transistors and backside power delivery, promising a 25% performance gain or 35% power reduction over N2, with Apple and Nvidia confirmed as launch customers for early 2027 silicon.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Modular End-Effector System
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform featuring a modular quick-swap end-effector system that allows operators to reconfigure the robot's hands for different industrial tasks in under 60 seconds. The platform ships with a suite of five effector types and a cloud-based task programming interface, targeting automotive and construction customers with initial deliveries in Q4 2026.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 1,000-Cycle Durability in Automotive Cell Format
articles.summary: QuantumScape published independently validated data showing its latest lithium-metal solid-state cells retain over 90% capacity after 1,000 fast-charge cycles in a full automotive pouch format, a milestone that had long eluded solid-state developers. The cells deliver roughly 500 Wh/kg at the cell level and charge from 10% to 80% in under 12 minutes, with Volkswagen's PowerCo confirming integration into a 2028 production vehicle.
